full_judgment:
Kashefa Hussain, J: This appeal is directed against judgment and decree dated 21.09.2016 (decree signed on 27.09.2016) passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 589 of 2016 dismissing the suit. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the judgment and decree dated 21.09.2016 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 589 of 2016 dismissing the suit, the plaintiff as appellant preferred the instant appeal. 

 22. In the result, the appeal is dismissed and the judgment and decree dated 21.09.2016 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 589 of 2016 is affirmed.
